definitions.explanation: The part of an object such as a pot, knife, or bag that is designed to be grasped and held by the hand.
A person who holds or possesses something, such as stocks, property, or rights.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{持|も}ち{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{握|にぎ}り→握る：02383_nigiru⟧やすい。
examples.english: This knife has an easy-to-grip handle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いた→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose a bag with a wooden handle.
The owner of the shares changed.
Who is the owner of this land?

examples.japanese: ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{手|て}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: As a property holder, there is an obligation to pay taxes.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold) and ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand). In sense 1, it refers to the part of an object designed to be held — a handle or grip. In sense 2, it refers to the person who holds or owns something. Context usually makes the intended sense clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持|も}ち{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to have a handle
- {持|も}ち{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to grip the handle
- {持|も}ち{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れる→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧: the handle breaks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}っ{手|て}→取っ手：24070_totte⟧: handle, knob — used for doors, drawers, and lids; designed for pulling or turning
- ⟦ハンドル→ハンドル：06331_handoru⟧: handle — loanword; also used for steering wheel
- ⟦{所有者|しょゆうしゃ}→所有者：21212_shoyuusha⟧: owner — formal term for an owner (sense 2 equivalent)
